Worm found in Greater Noida hostel meal, food safety team shuts kitchen
A viral video showed a worm in food served at a Greater Noida hostel mess. The inspection uncovered hygiene lapses, leading officials to suspend registration and shut the kitchen.
Wanted to become actor, joined BBA for family; 18-year-old jumps to death in Noida
Aditya Arora wanted to pursue acting, but enrolled in BBA to meet his family's expectations. He died by suicide, with police yet to confirm whether his aspirations were linked to his death.
Savings gone, no SMS: Greater Noida PNB customers in shock after Rs 35-crore fraud
Customers at a Greater Noida PNB branch allege nearly Rs 35 crore vanished from savings accounts and fixed deposits without their knowledge. Five employees, including the branch manager, have been suspended.
13-year-old boy dies after falling from 12th floor of Greater Noida society
A 13-year-old boy died after falling from the 12th floor of a Greater Noida residential building. Police are examining the circumstances and awaiting the post-mortem findings.
Man's demonetisation defence backfires, lands him in jail over unpaid loan
Court rejects claim that cheques were stolen; orders Rs 15 lakh fine, including Rs 14.75 lakh compensation for lender.
